title: Elf Bar 600 Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Compatible with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer a hassle-free way to enjoy some of Elf Bar’s most popular flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying draw and fast nicotine relief. Blue Razz Lemonade Flavour: A lively combination of sweet blue raspberry and zesty lemonade. The juicy berry flavour is lifted by a refreshing citrus sparkle, creating a tangy yet smooth vape with a crisp, fizzy sensation. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're moving away from disposables or looking for a more practical way to enjoy Elf Bar’s premium flavours, these prefilled pods offer a consistently great vaping experience.
